name: Long-Term Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Applicants need secured employment with a locally registered company. The process runs through two separate government bodies: the Ministry of Labor issues a work card, and the DRC Migration Authority issues the long-term work permit itself, described by the source as a 'multi-step and complex process.'
requirements.fix_path: Secure local employment, obtain the Ministry of Labor work card, then apply to the Migration Authority for the long-term work permit.

requirements.blocker_text: A separate entry-exit visa, valid for 7 months after first use, is required in addition to the work permit itself.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain the entry-exit visa alongside the work permit application.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract with a registered local company

sources.title: Work Permit DRC (private immigration-services site) -- the two-body Ministry of Labor / Migration Authority process, 2-year renewable permit duration, and the separate 7-month entry-exit visa requirement
